title: Part Forty-Three: The Verdict and What to Watch

sections.brief: The whole hypothesis scored in 25 sub-claims across all seven books (destination, carriers, occasion, machinery, brakes, force, turn on critics, destination reached), each with grade, grounding part and where the record runs against; separate rows and a table for non-citizens and citizens; aggregate labelled as the platform's editorial synthesis with method disclosed (unweighted tally 10 documented / 5 probable / 1 possible join / 9 not supported; weakest-necessary-link chain rule). Figures: compare, compare

Cir. (argued 14 May, undecided), Albanese stay, Cleland, California v. HHS, TANF notice, PEER; Army PDE (15 Nov 2026), ICE ERO order (to 4 May 2027), ICM/ImmigrationOS vehicle (to 26 Sep 2027), HART IOC unconfirmed; DHS OIG audit, Goldman letter, NSPM-7 list, Treasury nonprofit review; midterms 3 Nov 2026, Insurrection Act, Vance 2028; 702 certifications to 17 Mar 2027; ICE funds to 30 Sep 2029. The closing: what held (courts, states, cities, juries, employees, journalists, Urbit's galaxy vote, Honduras, Congress) and what ordinary people can do that the record shows works (know the warrant line and passport rule, encryption, state privacy laws and California DROP, FOIA, local and electoral government, supporting plaintiffs, reporters and auditors); closes Part Forty-Three and the book with the worst-case test.
